newsitem.title: CHINA: China military band gears up for HK handover.
newsitem.headline: China military band gears up for HK handover.

text.p: A military band and an honour guard of China's People's Liberation Army are practising late into the night for the midnight handover ceremony of Hong Kong to China next week, the Liberation Army Daily said on Monday.

The band and the honour guard flew to the southern boomtown of Shenzhen near Hong Kong from Beijing on Sunday to make final preparations for their performance at the handover ceremony in Hong Kong at midnight on June 30, the newspaper said.
They would also perform at the swearing-in ceremony of Hong Kong's future leader and new government on July 1, it said.
The band practised daily after 10 p.m. (1400 GMT) in preparation for the midnight ceremony, the newspaper said.
Hong Kong returns to China after more than 150 years of British colonial rule.
